groups capture text and number by opening parens, inner after outer
groups that do not participate in the match capture undefined
quantified groups capture the last completed repetition

backslash escapes metacharacters to literals
invalid patterns throw TypeError with the exact prefixed messages

a mid-run add waits for a genuinely free pass and never exceeds the cap

blocked and expired jobs never consume a slot; live jobs run beside them and dead subtrees stay dead
a retrying job past its deadline expires instead of running its next attempt

a mixed workload plays out deterministically end to end
